badges.name: CNC Capable
badges.description: Can set up and run a job on the CNC router with a mentor nearby.

badges.name: CNC Master
badges.description: Runs the CNC independently, from CAM to finished part, and can train others.

badges.name: Mill Capable
badges.description: Can safely set up and make basic cuts on the mill.

badges.name: Mill Master
badges.description: Mills precision parts independently and can train others.

badges.name: Lathe Capable
badges.description: Can safely set up and turn basic parts on the lathe.

badges.name: Lathe Master
badges.description: Turns precision parts independently and can train others.

badges.name: 3D Print Capable
badges.description: Can slice and run a print, and clear common failures.

badges.name: 3D Print Master
badges.description: Maintains the printers and designs parts for printing.

badges.name: Wiring Capable
badges.description: Wires components to team standards with clean, labeled runs.

badges.name: Wiring Master
badges.description: Lays out and wires a full robot electrical system.

badges.name: Pneumatics Capable
badges.description: Can plumb and leak-check a pneumatic circuit.

badges.name: Pneumatics Master
badges.description: Designs pneumatic systems and sizes cylinders and tanks.

badges.name: Soldering Capable
badges.description: Makes clean, reliable solder joints and splices.

badges.name: Soldering Master
badges.description: Does board-level soldering and repair, and can train others.

badges.name: CAD Capable
badges.description: Models and constrains parts from a drawing.

badges.name: CAD Master
badges.description: Designs full mechanisms and assemblies for the robot.

badges.name: Java/C++ Capable
badges.description: Writes and deploys working robot code.

badges.name: Java/C++ Master
badges.description: Structures subsystems and reviews other students' code.

badges.name: PID Tuning Capable
badges.description: Can tune a PID loop on a mechanism.

badges.name: PID Tuning Master
badges.description: Tunes complex control loops and explains the tradeoffs.

badges.name: Autonomous Programming
badges.description: Wrote an autonomous routine that ran in a match.

badges.name: Vision / Sensors
badges.description: Integrated a camera or sensor into robot code.

badges.name: Grant Writing Capable
badges.description: Drafted a section of a grant application.

badges.name: Grant Writing Master
badges.description: Led a full grant application from start to finish.

badges.name: Grant Submitted
badges.description: A grant you worked on was submitted.

badges.name: $1000+ Raised
badges.description: Helped raise $1000 or more for the team.

badges.name: $5000+ Raised
badges.description: Helped raise $5000 or more for the team.

badges.name: Ran Outreach Event
badges.description: Organized and ran an outreach event.

badges.name: Volunteer Hours
badges.description: Logged volunteer hours at FIRST or community events.

badges.name: Engineering Notebook
badges.description: Made a strong contribution to the engineering notebook.

badges.name: Perfect Attendance
badges.description: Didn't miss a meeting all season.

badges.name: Off-Season Event
badges.description: Competed at an off-season event.

badges.name: Taught a Skill
badges.description: Taught a skill to another student.

badges.name: Subteam Lead
badges.description: Led a subteam for a season.

badges.name: Director
badges.description: Served as a team director.
